Raised in Amsterdam, he ran telecom shops with his brother before establishing the subscription business. After its sale to T-Mobile, he turned to residential property through Elfi, developing and managing housing rather than returning to telecoms.

long_biography.plain_text:
Jasper de Rooij built Simpel around customers whom larger mobile operators often rejected. Instead of relying on their usual credit checks, he required an initial payment before dispatching a SIM card. A successful collection provided confirmation of the customer’s bank account and address, giving the business a practical way to serve that market.

At property company Elfi, he applied similar attention to routine processes. His plans used standard kitchens, flooring and fittings across apartments, with spare parts kept available for repairs. He wanted technicians to arrive equipped for the job, avoiding a separate inspection and return visit.
